title: S1: Add the Corpus config with PLANTED; planted replays stay byte-identical
description:
## Purpose

Introduce a frozen `Corpus` config so the harness can run more than the planted corpus.

## Scope

New `unified_corpus.py` with the `PLANTED` corpus (labels, task, few-shot feature names, rubric seed, prompts); `unified_splits` / `unified_loop` / `unified_cli` read from it; `--corpus {planted,emotion}` flag, planted default. Start from committed state (a4391f2); no bios code.

## Specs (first, beside the module)

`PLANTED` equals the current constants; CLI defaults to planted; unknown corpus rejected; replay byte-identity (cross-module, `tests/`).

## Reuse

`unified_splits.load_splits`, `TASK` in `unified_loop.py`.

## Definition of done

Both planted replays (`var/unified-flywheel/phase2-live-seed1`, `seed2-live`) reproduce byte-identically; `make test` green.

## Cost

$0 (offline, no network).

## Links

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md); [UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md)

comments.text: S1 done offline, $0, no network. Evaluations commit 8a539d7 (local, not pushed): new unified_corpus.py (frozen Corpus, PLANTED, registry with only 'planted'), --corpus {planted} on run and comments (default planted); splits/loop/knn/retrieval/cli read from it (old module constants kept as PLANTED-derived aliases for existing specs). Results: make unified-flywheel-test 130 passed (existing specs unchanged, 8 new); make test 379 passed 5 skipped. Replays of COPIES with --replay, 0 requests: phase2-live-seed1 rounds and final: predictions byte-identical to the original, summary per-round metrics/bundle hashes identical; seed2-live final byte-identical; seed2 rounds: pre-change code ALSO fails full-arm replay (2 failed live F round-3 requests never cached), so rounds were replayed without arm F (rows identical for 0,F-rand,A-c,A-c+F) and pre-change vs post-change replay outputs are byte-identical for every summary/predictions/run-log file.
